profile.description: Measured low-TTFA starting profile for concurrent streaming requests on an 8-core Intel AMX host.

hardware.notes: The host exposes 16 logical CPUs for 8 physical cores. The measured prefork mapping spans CPUs 0-15; with SMT enabled, sibling placement must be verified before treating this as a physical-core topology.

requirements.isa: AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AMX tile, AMX INT8 and AMX BF16

server.worker_affinity: measured engine mapping: worker 0 -> CPU 0-3; worker 1 -> 4-7; worker 2 -> 8-11; worker 3 -> 12-15

precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; int8 packing is internal to matmat
precision.gemm_backend: AMX INT8 GEMM where the gate is met; shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI GEMM fallback; scalar/vector fallback otherwise

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Must be absent so the engine can size OpenBLAS per phase from each worker thread budget.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: set it explicitly only for a measured override

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Avoids idle OpenBLAS workers spinning against the engine pool.

QWEN_AMX_MIN_B.why: Allows AMX INT8 matmat from the first batched regime qualified by the engine.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Enables reuse of request-independent prefix work.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI tile path is available when AMX is bypassed.
QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.revert: set QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE=1 only for a VNNI row-kernel control run

qualification.workload: Concurrent streaming requests at client concurrency 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 with a mixed-length text bank.
qualification.notes: The topology was measured as a low-TTFA candidate on this 8-core host. Requalify after the clean OSS VNNI tile path is included; this profile is not a throughput claim.
